text.name: Colour Revolutions
text.rules: Record "colour revolution". LIO spends 2 points. Until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 more.
text.history: Georgia's Rose Revolution forced President Shevardnadze to resign on 23 November 2003 after a disputed election; Ukraine's Orange Revolution, from 22 November 2004 into January 2005, overturned a disputed presidential run-off.
